[media]
                                               
# 🎃 Halloween has officially landed at the airport, Rookie! 

[media]    

Things are about to get spooky, so gear up with the Spook Squad Kit and bring some Halloween chaos to your shift. 🕷️👻 The creepiest passengers are waiting!

[media]
# Patrol Partner 🐶🐾

Meet your **loyal Patrol Partner**! Your K9 companion helps you spot suspicious passengers, uncover hidden trouble, and stay one step ahead. Feed and grow your partner to unlock even more helpful abilities.

[media]

# Sabotage Tools & Kits 😈🔥

**Create chaos** for rival guards with powerful sabotage tools and combine them into Kits to take control of every shift—from Cadet to Captain. 💥

[media]

# Multiplayer Mode

**Compete against other guards**, slow down rival lines, and prove you're the best officer at the airport.

[media]

# Keep the Airport Safe

**Scan bags**, **inspect passengers**, **uncover contraband**, **search the new Baggage Claim**, and **stop every smuggler** before it's too late. 

[media]

# Stay sharp

Time’s ticking ⏱️—**scan bags, check passengers, uncover contraband, and keep the line moving**. Miss one? **BOOM! 💥✈️**

Join the community: **https://discord.com/invite/etermaxrstudio**
